summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for BudgetMitra — an offline-first student money manager for Indian college students built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, and Capacitor 8 Android integration with on-device SQLite, native SMS parser plugin, multilingual support (English, Hindi, Marathi), financial health analytics, bill splitting with WhatsApp and UPI deep linking, loan/EMI calculator, scholarship matcher, and full APK build pipeline.
